text: Just 3 minutes in, Jonah Lindqvist struck for Ironvale Athletic to make it 1-0 against Redmond Rovers. His goal came from a quick counter-attack that started with an interception near Ironvale’s own 24-meter line. After a short, sharp team move with just three passes over 20 seconds, Teo Quinlan fed Lindqvist a perfect through ball, who then calmly finished from close range. This smart, fast break caught Redmond’s high press off guard and evened the score early on[#40] [#45] [#50].
